source.citation: Li Y, Al Rimon R, Wang F, et al. Temporal inhibition of ADAM17 in fibroblasts reduces stiffness and promotes vascularization following myocardial infarction. Cardiovascular Research. 2026;122(1):112-131.

timing_experiment.early_regimen: PZ0416 started 2 days before MI and continued through 4 days after MI
timing_experiment.delayed_regimen: PZ0416 started day 3 after MI and continued for 4 days, days 3-7
timing_experiment.early_result: No material improvement in survival, infarct size, LV dilation or dysfunction in the early/pre-MI regimen.
timing_experiment.delayed_result: Treatment beginning after the initial scar-formation phase reduced infarct expansion and improved LV dilation/dysfunction through 4 weeks.
timing_experiment.timing_interpretation: The same molecular target has phase-dependent effects: initial ADAM17 activity participates in necessary early scar formation, whereas persistent activity becomes a later adverse-remodeling target.

mechanistic_context.myofibroblast_genetic_arm: Postn-lineage Adam17 knockdown after MI reduced infarct expansion and ECM/fibrotic markers.
mechanistic_context.mechanical_measurement: In a separate myofibroblast genetic arm, infarct stiffness was lower with Adam17 loss (reported instantaneous modulus approximately 23.68 kPa versus 33.7 kPa in controls at 1 week).
mechanistic_context.pathway: ADAM17 -> EGFR activity -> YAP nuclear mechanotransduction/pro-fibrotic program; reduced ADAM17 was associated with reduced stiffness and greater vascularization.
mechanistic_context.root_integrity_warning: The delayed pharmacological arm and the direct stiffness measurement belong to distinct experimental arms and must not be fused into a synthetic strict mechanical 5/5 root.

janus_classification.reason: The delayed intervention is molecular, not direct physical retuning; direct tissue stiffness measurement is reported in a separate genetic arm rather than the delayed pharmacological root.

falsification_value: The lack of benefit from the pre-MI/very-early regimen argues against a simple TARGET_INHIBITION_AT_ANY_TIME_IS_BENEFICIAL model and supports phase-specific intervention logic.
next_action: Search HEART/SPINAL_CORD for one single experimental root with delayed direct physical retuning, contemporaneous tissue-mechanics measurement, endogenous repair-state trajectory and preserved structural integrity.
